description: WeChat Official Account (微信公众号) publishing pipeline: format Markdown or plain text into WeChat-compatible inline-style HTML with 7 polished themes (dark mode and mobile font sizes tuned), optionally generate a cover image with brightness check and auto-darkening, and push one or many articles to the WeChat draft box (多图文).
